title: Blow-up change of variables for μHE[n] under η_{x,r}
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[n] on ℝ^P = Eucl P, x ∈ ℝ^P, r > 0, S ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set and g : ℝ^P → ℝ an arbitrary function. Let η := η_{x,r} = blowUpMap x r, so η(z) = r⁻¹(z − x). Then the Bochner integrals satisfy ∫_{η(S)} g dH = (rⁿ)⁻¹ · ∫_S g(η(z)) dH(z). No measurability or integrability assumption is made; a non-integrable integrand has integral 0 on either side.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Eucl P) (r : ℝ) (S : Set (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' S, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in S, g (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
